item.title: Ravens Finalize 2026 Coaching Staff, What Comes Next
item.description: Team insiders Garrett Downing and Clifton Brown break down the new coaching staff under Jesse Minter and what Ravens fans can expect from this group. They also discuss big items on the horizon, including the scouting combine and contract extensions.

item.title: Anthony Weaver Talks Returning to Ravens as New Defensive Coordinator
item.description: Ravens Defensive Coordinator Anthony Weaver joins Garrett Downing and Clifton Brown to discuss his process during the offseason coaching carousel, the decision to come back to Baltimore and his expectations for this Ravens defense.

item.title: Declan Doyle Joins The Lounge, Discusses Role as Ravens Offensive Coordinator
item.description: Ravens Offensive Coordinator Declan Doyle stops by The Lounge to discuss his decision to come to Baltimore, teaming up with new Head Coach Jesse Minter and his visions for building an offense that features quarterback Lamar Jackson.

item.title: Jesse Minter, Anthony Weaver, Declan Doyle, & Anthony Levine Sr.: Ravens Press Conference 2/18/26
item.description: Head Coach Jesse Minter, Defensive Coordinator Anthony Weaver, Offensive Coordinator Declan Doyle, and Special Teams Coordinator Anthony Levine Sr. speak with the media on Wednesday.

item.title: Reaction to Coordinators' Introductory Press Conference
item.description: Team insiders Cassie Cherigo and Clifton Brown give their takeaways from Wednesday's press conference with the Ravens' coordinators, including Offensive Coordinator Declan Doyle's relationship with Lamar Jackson, what Defensive Coordinator Anthony Weaver brings to the table, and more.
